decisions.text: type stacked_bar_100: the fractions within each total, for an audience that objects to pies: 100 % stacked bars (D-39)
scale 0–100 by 20: each total 100 %, its parts in % of it (R7-30, G7.32)
the totals sorted by their size, descending (R7-20, G2.1)

stacking order from the base: Operations, HR, Finance, Outreach, PR, Development (Operations, the parts the message names, at the base, where they are read precisely; the others largest first; G7.31, D-26 (b))
each part in one colour and one place in every total: Operations (slot 1), HR (slot 2), Finance (slot 3), Outreach (slot 4), PR (slot 5), Development (slot 6) (G4.22, G7.31)
every name fits under its stacked bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical stacked bars
the unit's description on its own line above the scale (inline it would meet the stacked bar of East): “Share of total expenses”; “100%” stays on the top label
each part named beside the last stack, level with the middle of its segment, top to bottom as stacked: Development, PR, Outreach, Finance, HR, Operations (G5.4, D-31 (c))
highlighted in the strong shade of their colour: East (Operations), Central (Operations), West (Operations); the others keep their colour
